what_each_new_part_touches: Sub-steps 1-3 (built twice): a black pin and a tan pin go into the end holes of a light-grey 5-hole beam, then a tyre goes on each wheel (yellow box) and the two wheels slide onto the pins.
The two finished carriers are attached to the undercarriage with the black arrows (the model is turned over first).
where_everything_is_after: two roller carriers (a 5-hole beam with two small tyred wheels each) are attached to the undercarriage

why.problem_solved: Adds the small rollers that the track will run on.
why.why_these_parts: Free-spinning wheels on pins keep friction low; the grey 5-hole beam is the right length to hold two wheels one track-link apart.
why.sets_up_for_later: Steps 10 onward build the track wheels and the track loop around these rollers.

review_note: The parts box shows tan x4, black x4 (pin with axle), 2 grey beams, 4 tyres and 4 wheels. Which of the two pin types goes in which hole was read from sub-steps 1-2 and is an estimate. The attachment holes on the undercarriage are not shown.
